at-0001.content: Round monetary results only via ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

at-0006.title: Money operations accept idempotency_key and check it first
at-0006.content: Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance (e.g. `refund` in `ledgerly/adjustments.py`) must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it before any validation: scan `ledgerly.audit.events()` for a matching key and return the original result without reapplying. Include `idempotency_key` in the `audit.record` entry.
